pending.title: Rainy Night Cinematic Portrait
pending.prompt: An ultra-photorealistic cinematic waist-up portrait of the person in the photo standing in heavy rain at night. Frame them from the waist upward, centered and facing the camera, with relaxed shoulders and a natural, slightly vulnerable posture. The person has a lean athletic physique, refined masculine facial features, fair warm-toned skin, dark brown eyes, thick eyebrows, defined cheekbones, and dark naturally tousled hair completely soaked by the rain. Wet strands fall across their forehead and temples, with individual strands clearly visible. They are wearing a wet, unbuttoned white shirt clinging to their skin, revealing a toned chest with water droplets. Use a blurred city street at night with warm glowing street lamps in the background, dramatic cinematic lighting, and a shallow depth of field. Keep the person's face and identity unchanged.
